stories.title: Última hora de la actualidad política, en directo | Cientos de personas esperan a los Reyes en Ceuta

en.title: Latest political news live | Hundreds of people await the Kings in Ceuta
en.summary: The Spanish monarchs will be received in Ceuta and travel to Melilla on Wednesday. Irene Montero confirms talks with the Frente Amplio, while Sumar expresses continued hope that Podemos will join the project.

stories.title: Los sindicatos exigen al Gobierno una subida del salario mínimo del 7% en 2027, hasta los 1.306,5 euros

en.title: Trade unions demand 7% minimum wage increase for 2027, up to 1,306.5 euros
en.summary: CCOO and UGT unions are calling for a general strike, citing housing affordability as a key concern, arguing that wage levels must support workers' ability to access housing.

stories.title: CC OO y UGT reclaman que el salario mínimo suba un 7% en 2027

en.title: CCOO and UGT demand 7% minimum wage increase in 2027
en.summary: Two major trade union federations are calling for a general strike with labor demands focused on wage increases sufficient for workers to afford housing.

stories.title: Montero confirma “conversaciones” con el Frente Amplio: “Lo importante es llegar a buen puerto”

en.title: Montero confirms "conversations" with Frente Amplio: "The important thing is to reach a good outcome"
en.summary: Irene Montero confirms ongoing discussions with the Frente Amplio coalition. The Comuns party reports that all possible avenues for reaching agreement are being explored.

stories.title: El expresidente madrileño Ignacio González se declara inocente en el arranque de su primer juicio de Lezo

en.title: Former Madrid president Ignacio González declares himself innocent at the start of his first Lezo trial
en.summary: Former PP leader Ignacio González pleaded not guilty to allegations of involvement in contract rigging at the Canal de Isabel II golf course, a scheme allegedly devised by Esperanza Aguirre.

stories.title: El ex presidente madrileño Ignacio González niega las acusaciones en la primera jornada de su juicio por el 'caso Lezo'

en.title: Former Madrid president Ignacio González denies accusations on the first day of his Lezo case trial
en.summary: The Anti-Corruption Prosecutor's Office is seeking six-year prison sentences for alleged bribery crimes and a 550,000 euro fine against Ignacio González.

stories.title: Bardella arropa a Abascal hacia el 29-N cargando contra la política migratoria de Sánchez por sus "consecuencias dramáticas para el equilibrio" de Europa

en.title: Bardella supports Abascal towards 29-N attacking Sánchez's migration policy for its 'dramatic consequences for Europe's balance'
en.summary: Vox leader Abascal received backing from French ally Bardella as he began campaigning, emphasizing alliances based on sovereignty respect and framing immigration as a European issue.

stories.title: Dani Carvajal ficha por el Getafe tras tres meses sin equipo

en.title: Dani Carvajal signs with Getafe after three months without a team
en.summary: Former Real Madrid captain Dani Carvajal joined Getafe as a free agent following the expiration of his contract with Madrid in June, with an official presentation planned for the following Friday.

stories.title: La alta velocidad Madrid-Barcelona sigue afectada tras el incendio: Renfe maniobra para reducir las demoras y cancela trayectos con Navarra

en.title: Madrid-Barcelona high-speed rail continues disrupted after fire: Renfe maneuvers to reduce delays and cancels Navarre routes
en.summary: High-speed rail service between Madrid and Barcelona remains affected following a fire. Renfe is managing delays and has cancelled certain routes while offering free changes and cancellations for affected passengers.

stories.title: Demoras y suspensiones en el AVE entre Madrid y Barcelona tras el incendio que paralizó la línea

en.title: Delays and suspensions on AVE between Madrid and Barcelona after fire halted line
en.summary: A fire in a high-speed train's tail cabin disrupted the Madrid-Barcelona line yesterday. Service began recovering overnight, though disruptions and delays were expected to continue on Tuesday.

stories.title: Continúan los retrasos en los trenes entre Madrid y Barcelona por el incendio de ayer en el AVE

en.title: Delays continue on trains between Madrid and Barcelona due to yesterday's AVE fire
en.summary: Multiple trains from both Madrid and Barcelona were rescheduled to depart approximately one hour later due to ongoing effects from the previous day's fire incident.

stories.title: La alta velocidad entre Madrid y Barcelona sufre demoras y cambios horarios por el tren incendiado ayer

en.title: High-speed rail between Madrid and Barcelona experiences delays and schedule changes due to train fire yesterday
en.summary: The damaged Renfe train remains on tracks near Ricla, forcing single-track operation at reduced speeds in that area and causing service disruptions.

stories.title: Las criptomonedas alternativas sufren un correctivo de hasta el 10%

en.title: Alternative cryptocurrencies suffer a correction of up to 10%
en.summary: Altcoins experienced significant declines, with losses reaching 10% in 24 hours and 15% over the past week. Zcash, monero, hiperliquid, and cardano were among the most affected assets.

stories.title: Los decretos causan la retirada de 4.235 viviendas del alquiler en sólo diez días

en.title: Decrees cause withdrawal of 4,235 rental homes in just ten days
en.summary: A government housing decree prompted the removal of thousands of residential properties from the rental market. Nearly 89% of real estate agencies reported measurable impacts on the rental sector.

stories.title: El Ibex busca esquivar el revés a la IA

en.title: Ibex seeks to avoid AI setback
en.summary: Asian markets experienced losses linked to artificial intelligence stocks, though European equities remained relatively stable. The Ibex consolidated gains while oil and debt markets provided support.

stories.title: Calendario laboral 2027: días festivos, fines de semana largos y puentes de todo el año

en.title: 2027 work calendar: public holidays, long weekends and bridges throughout the year
en.summary: Spain's official work calendar for 2027 was published, featuring 12 national public holidays with nine dates observed nationwide.

stories.title: Las gestoras españolas trasladan a Luxemburgo 12.700 millones en fondos

en.title: Spanish asset managers transfer 12.7 billion euros in funds to Luxembourg
en.summary: Spanish asset management firms are accelerating the transfer of their operations to Luxembourg, where administered assets have surged 68% to reach a record 31.5 billion euros.
